criteria.criterion: A1/A2 all 5 embeddings evaluated on same S_old, outer folds, and test participants; selected_items_by_fold_ratio_embedding.json verifies fixed original selected items.
criteria.notes: run_phase4_versionA.py loads one fixed Phase 1 Coverage set per fold×ratio via load_fixed_s_old_by_fold_ratio() and reuses it across all embeddings and both versions. selected_items_by_fold_ratio_embedding.json records 200 audit rows with reused_across_embeddings=true and reused_across_versions=true, and the inspected output showed exactly one selected_S_hash for each fold×ratio. Participant-level outputs were also checked for identical subject_id sequences across every embedding/version within each fold×ratio, with no alignment mismatches found.

criteria.criterion: A1 uses fixed Phase 2 recommended hyperparameters and no embedding-specific K/τ tuning; hyperparameters file verifies fixed settings.
criteria.notes: A1_FIXED_PARAMS hard-codes ratio-specific settings {10:(7,0.1), 30:(7,0.1), 50:(10,0.1), 90:(3,0.03)} and the main loop applies them whenever version == A1_fixed. The hyperparameter artifact shows all A1 rows as is_fixed=true, is_tuned=false, hyperparam_source=phase2_fixed_preregistered_softmax, with those exact K/τ values for every fold and embedding. The inspected Phase 2 softmax_kernel_detail.csv modal SoftmaxKNN settings by ratio match the A1 fixed values.

criteria.criterion: A2 K/τ tuning fully train-inner only; test participants not used for tuning.
criteria.notes: A2 tuning is isolated in tune_a2(), which receives only y_train from the outer-training fold, creates an inner split with inner_validation_split(), searches the K×τ grid there, and returns best settings before any prediction on y_test. In the main loop, y_test is first used only after tuning completes. The hyperparameter CSV records train_n, train_inner_n, valid_inner_n, test_n, the K/τ search spaces, and per-grid inner validation scores for A2 rows, confirming nested tuning metadata is being captured.

criteria.criterion: Version A results table contains embedding×ratio×version item-level Pearson r, MAE, trait_r_mean, profile_r, and per-participant predictions saved.
criteria.notes: versionA_results.csv has 200 rows covering 2 versions × 5 embeddings × 4 ratios × 5 folds, with non-null item_r, item_mae, trait_r_mean, and profile_r columns. versionA_predictions.parquet exists with 109960 per-participant rows and vector fields for held-out item IDs, y_true, and continuous predictions; versionA_participant_metrics.csv provides subject-level scalar metrics. artifact-checks.txt confirms row counts and schema completeness.

criteria.criterion: New embeddings vs SBERT original use paired bootstrap over participants, reporting Δ, 95% CI, raw p and Holm/BH corrected p.
criteria.notes: build_bootstrap_tests() pairs each new embedding against SBERT original by subject_id and outer_fold, computes subject-level deltas, and calls paired_bootstrap_by_fold(), which resamples subjects within each outer fold. versionA_statistical_tests.csv has 32 rows (4 new embeddings × 4 ratios × 2 versions) and includes delta_mean, ci_lower, ci_upper, p_raw, p_holm, and p_bh. The artifact also records bootstrap_unit=subjects_resampled_within_outer_fold and bootstrap_iterations=10000 for the full run.

criteria.criterion: Primary prediction is continuous clip-only, not rounded; rounded accuracy/MAE supplemental only.
criteria.notes: phase4_predictors.py introduces ContinuousSoftmaxKNN, which clips predictions to [1,5] but does not round them. run_phase4_versionA.py records prediction_mode=continuous_clip_only_primary in participant metrics, sets rounded=false in the primary fold-level results, and stores rounded outputs only in supplemental columns such as y_pred_rounded_supplemental, item_rounded_accuracy, item_rounded_mae, per_subject_rounded_accuracy, and per_subject_rounded_mae. The saved parquet sample inspected contained distinct continuous and rounded values, confirming rounding is supplemental rather than primary.
